title: AI startup Reflection says it has signed a $1B+ deal to secure computing capacity from Nebius, including access to Nvidia chips, following a deal with SpaceX (Aditya Soni/Reuters)
summary: Aditya Soni / Reuters: AI startup Reflection says it has signed a $1B+ deal to secure computing capacity from Nebius, including access to Nvidia chips, following a deal with SpaceX — AI startup Reflection said on Tuesday it has signed a more than $1 billion deal to secure computing capacity from Nebius (NBIS.O), including access to Nvidia's latest chips.
